061/**
062 * Validates a SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} document and produces a {@link ClaimsPrincipal} marked
063 * with {@code issuerType=SAML}.
064 *
065 * <p>
066 * Wraps OpenSAML 5.x's parser, unmarshaller, signature validator, and (optionally) assertion decrypter.
067 * The validator enforces:
068 *
069 * <ul>
070 *    <li><b>Mandatory assertion signature</b> &mdash; every assertion must carry its own enveloped signature.
071 *       A response that signs only the {@code <Response>} envelope (and not the assertion) is rejected as
072 *       unsigned; response-envelope-level signatures are not supported.
073 *    <li><b>Strict signature-algorithm allowlist</b> &mdash; only {@code rsa-sha256} and
074 *       {@code ecdsa-sha256} are accepted out of the box.  SHA-1 is permanently rejected.  The reference
075 *       {@code DigestMethod} is separately allowlisted (SHA-256/384/512), so a SHA-1 digest is rejected even
076 *       under a SHA-256 signature.
077 *    <li><b>Response status</b> &mdash; the {@code <samlp:Status>} must report the {@code Success} status code.
078 *    <li><b>Clock skew</b> &mdash; defaults to 60 seconds tolerance on {@code NotBefore} /
079 *       {@code NotOnOrAfter}; capped at 300 seconds.
080 *    <li><b>Audience restriction</b> &mdash; {@code <AudienceRestriction>} must list the configured SP entity ID.
081 *    <li><b>Bearer subject confirmation</b> &mdash; always enforced.  The ACS URL configured with
082 *       {@link Builder#recipient(String)} is required, and the assertion must carry a {@code bearer}
083 *       {@code <SubjectConfirmation>} whose {@code <SubjectConfirmationData>} names exactly that {@code Recipient},
084 *       is within its {@code NotBefore}/{@code NotOnOrAfter} window (the {@code NotOnOrAfter} is mandatory), and
085 *       satisfies the configured {@code Address} expectation.  The recipient is never taken from the request.
086 *       When the response carries a {@code Destination}, it must equal the configured ACS URL.
087 *    <li><b>Request binding</b> &mdash; a confirmation carrying {@code InResponseTo} must reference an
088 *       authentication request ID previously registered with {@link #rememberAuthnRequest(String)}; each ID is
089 *       accepted once.  A confirmation with no {@code InResponseTo} (an IdP-initiated response) is rejected unless
090 *       {@link Builder#allowIdpInitiated()} was set.
091 *    <li><b>One-time use</b> &mdash; each assertion ID is recorded in a {@link ReplayCache} and a second
092 *       presentation of the same ID is rejected.  The check is fail-closed: if the cache cannot answer, the
093 *       assertion is rejected.  An assertion whose validity window is unbounded &mdash; carrying neither a
094 *       {@code Conditions/NotOnOrAfter} nor a bearer {@code SubjectConfirmationData/NotOnOrAfter} &mdash; is
095 *       rejected outright, and the cache record is retained until the resolved {@code NotOnOrAfter} (plus clock
096 *       skew) rather than a short default window that would later expire and re-open replay.
097 *    <li><b>Encrypted assertions</b> &mdash; if the response contains
098 *       {@code <EncryptedAssertion>}, a {@code decryptionCredential} must be configured.  Only RSA-OAEP key
099 *       transport and AES-GCM content encryption are accepted, and every decryption problem is reported with the
100 *       same generic error.
101 * </ul>
102 *
103 * <h2 class='topic'>Marker claim</h2>
104 * <p>
105 * The returned {@link ClaimsPrincipal} is annotated with {@code issuerType=SAML} so downstream code
106 * can distinguish SAML-derived principals from JWT-derived principals without resorting to a subclass:
107 *
108 * <p class='bjava'>
109 *    <jk>if</jk> (<js>"SAML"</js>.equals(<jv>principal</jv>.getClaim(<js>"issuerType"</js>, String.<jk>class</jk>).orElse(<jk>null</jk>))) {
110 *       <jc>// SAML-issued principal</jc>
111 *    }
112 * </p>
113 *
114 * <h2 class='topic'>Builder usage</h2>
115 *
116 * <p>
117 * The ACS URL is mandatory.  Register each outgoing authentication request ID with
118 * {@link #rememberAuthnRequest(String)} so the response can be bound to it.
119 *
120 * <p class='bjava'>
121 *    <jk>var</jk> validator = SamlAssertionValidator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
122 *       .metadataResolver(SamlMetadataResolvers.<jsm>url</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/metadata"</js>))
123 *       .spEntityId(<js>"https://sp.example.com"</js>)
124 *       .expectedIssuer(<js>"https://idp.example.com"</js>)
125 *       .recipient(<js>"https://sp.example.com/saml/acs"</js>)
126 *       .build();
127 * </p>
128 *
129 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2>
130 * <ul>
131 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlAuthFilter}
132 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlMetadataResolvers}
133 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://docs.oasis-open.org/security/saml/v2.0/saml-core-2.0-os.pdf">SAML 2.0 Core (OASIS)</a>
134 * </ul>
135 *
136 * @since 10.0.0
137 */
138@SuppressWarnings({
139   "java:S1192", // Duplicate string literals are SAML protocol claim names and JWT-style field keys; intentional
140   "java:S6539" // Monolithic class: validator is a single end-to-end pipeline.
141})
142public class SamlAssertionValidator {
143
144   private static final SecureRandom SECURE_RANDOM = new SecureRandom();
145   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(SamlAssertionValidator.class.getName());

147   /** Marker claim name on the returned {@link ClaimsPrincipal}. */
148   public static final String ISSUER_TYPE_CLAIM = "issuerType";
149
150   /** Marker claim value identifying the principal as SAML-issued. */
151   public static final String ISSUER_TYPE_SAML = "SAML";
152
153   /** Maximum clock-skew tolerance the builder will accept (5 minutes). */
154   private static final Duration MAX_CLOCK_SKEW = Duration.ofSeconds(300);
155
156   /** XML-DSig namespace URI, used when scanning the signature DOM for reference digest methods. */
157   private static final String XMLSIG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#";

159   /** Default allowlist of XML signature algorithms. */
160   private static final Set<String> DEFAULT_ALGORITHMS = Set.of(
161      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_SIGNATURE_RSA_SHA256,
162      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_SIGNATURE_ECDSA_SHA256
163   );
164
165   /** Decryption allowlist: RSA-OAEP key transport and AES-GCM content encryption only. */
166   private static final Set<String> DECRYPTION_ALGORITHMS = Set.of(
167      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_KEYTRANSPORT_RSAOAEP,
168      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_KEYTRANSPORT_RSAOAEP11,
169      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_BLOCKCIPHER_AES128_GCM,
170      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_BLOCKCIPHER_AES192_GCM,
171      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_BLOCKCIPHER_AES256_GCM,
172      // RSA-OAEP parameters: the OAEP digest (SHA-1 is the OAEP default and is not collision-sensitive there) and MGF1.
173      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA1,
174      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA256,
175      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA384,
176      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA512,
177      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_MGF1_SHA1,
178      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_MGF1_SHA256,
179      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_MGF1_SHA384,
180      EncryptionConstants.ALGO_ID_MGF1_SHA512
181   );
182
183   /** Default allowlist of XML reference digest algorithms.  SHA-1 is deliberately excluded. */
184   private static final Set<String> DEFAULT_DIGEST_ALGORITHMS = Set.of(
185      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA256,
186      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA384,
187      SignatureConstants.ALGO_ID_DIGEST_SHA512
188   );

213      private Duration clockSkew = Duration.ofSeconds(60);

224      /**
225       * Sets the {@link MetadataResolver} used to resolve the IdP's signing credential at validation time.
226       *
227       * <p>
228       * Mutually exclusive with {@link #signingCredential(Credential)}.
229       *
230       * <p>
231       * The metadata supplies the trust anchor, so prefer a resolver whose metadata signature is verified against
232       * a pinned certificate, e.g. {@link SamlMetadataResolvers#url(String, java.security.cert.X509Certificate)}.
233       * Unsigned metadata is only as trustworthy as the transport it was fetched over.
234       *
235       * @param value The metadata resolver.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
236       * @return This object.
237       */
238      public Builder metadataResolver(MetadataResolver value) {
239         metadataResolver = reqnn("value", value);
240         return this;
241      }
242
243      /**
244       * Sets a static IdP signing credential.  Useful when metadata is not available.
245       *
246       * <p>
247       * Mutually exclusive with {@link #metadataResolver(MetadataResolver)}.
248       *
249       * @param value The IdP signing credential.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
250       * @return This object.
251       */
252      public Builder signingCredential(Credential value) {
253         signingCredential = reqnn("value", value);
254         return this;
255      }
256
257      /**
258       * Sets the credential used to decrypt {@code <EncryptedAssertion>} elements.
259       *
260       * <p>
261       * If the response contains encrypted assertions and no decryption credential is configured,

263       *
264       * @param value The SP decryption credential.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
265       * @return This object.
266       */
267      public Builder decryptionCredential(Credential value) {
268         decryptionCredential = reqnn("value", value);

270      }
271
272      /**
273       * Sets the Service Provider entity ID used to validate {@code <AudienceRestriction>}.
274       *
275       * @param value The SP entity ID.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
276       * @return This object.
277       */
278      public Builder spEntityId(String value) {
279         spEntityId = reqnb("value", value);
280         return this;
281      }
282
283      /**
284       * Sets the expected IdP issuer (the {@code <Issuer>} element).  Required.
285       *
286       * @param value The expected IdP entity ID.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
287       * @return This object.
288       */
289      public Builder expectedIssuer(String value) {
290         expectedIssuer = reqnb("value", value);
291         return this;
292      }
293
294      /**
295       * Replaces the default signature-algorithm allowlist with the supplied URIs.
296       *
297       * <p>
298       * SHA-1 algorithms are silently filtered out (permanent rejection).
299       *
300       * @param values The XML-DSig algorithm URIs to allow.  Must contain at least one non-SHA-1 entry.
301       * @return This object.
302       */
303      public Builder algorithms(String... values) {
304         reqnn("values", values);
305         if (values.length == 0)
306            throw iaex("algorithms allowlist must be non-empty");
307         var next = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
308         for (var a : values) {
309            reqnn("algorithm", a);
310            if (a.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("sha1"))
311               throw iaex("SHA-1 algorithms are permanently rejected: %s", a);
312            next.add(a);
313         }
314         algorithms = next;
315         return this;
316      }
317
318      /**
319       * Replaces the default reference-digest allowlist with the supplied URIs.
320       *
321       * <p>
322       * The reference {@code DigestMethod} of the enveloped signature must appear in this set.  SHA-1
323       * algorithms are silently filtered out (permanent rejection), mirroring {@link #algorithms(String...)}.
324       *
325       * @param values The XML-DSig digest algorithm URIs to allow.  Must contain at least one non-SHA-1 entry.
326       * @return This object.
327       */
328      public Builder digestAlgorithms(String... values) {
329         reqnn("values", values);
330         if (values.length == 0)
331            throw iaex("digest allowlist must be non-empty");
332         var next = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
333         for (var a : values) {
334            reqnn("digestAlgorithm", a);
335            if (a.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("sha1"))
336               throw iaex("SHA-1 digest algorithms are permanently rejected: %s", a);
337            next.add(a);
338         }
339         digestAlgorithms = next;
340         return this;
341      }
342
343      /**
344       * Sets the expected {@code Recipient} (this SP's Assertion Consumer Service URL).  Required.
345       *
346       * <p>
347       * Every validated assertion must carry a {@code bearer} {@code <SubjectConfirmation>} whose
348       * {@code <SubjectConfirmationData>} names this exact {@code Recipient}, is within its
349       * {@code NotBefore}/{@code NotOnOrAfter} window, and satisfies the {@link #subjectAddress(String)}
350       * expectation.  A response carrying a {@code Destination} must name this URL as well.
351       *
352       * @param value The expected ACS URL.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
353       * @return This object.
354       */
355      public Builder recipient(String value) {
356         recipient = reqnb("value", value);
357         return this;
358      }
359
360      /**
361       * Pins the request ID a bearer {@code <SubjectConfirmationData>} must echo in its {@code InResponseTo}
362       * attribute.
363       *
364       * <p>
365       * When set, the confirmation's {@code InResponseTo} must equal this value.  When left unset (the default),
366       * a present {@code InResponseTo} must reference an ID registered with
367       * {@link SamlAssertionValidator#rememberAuthnRequest(String)}.
368       *
369       * @param value The expected request ID.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
370       * @return This object.
371       */
372      public Builder expectedInResponseTo(String value) {
373         expectedInResponseTo = reqnb("value", value);
374         return this;
375      }
376
377      /**
378       * Sets the client address a bearer {@code <SubjectConfirmationData>} must name in its {@code Address}
379       * attribute.
380       *
381       * <p>
382       * When set, the confirmation's
383       * {@code Address} must equal this value; when unset (the default) the {@code Address} attribute is not
384       * checked.
385       *
386       * @param value The expected client address.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
387       * @return This object.
388       */
389      public Builder subjectAddress(String value) {
390         expectedAddress = reqnb("value", value);
391         return this;
392      }
393
394      /**
395       * Overrides the {@link ReplayCache} used to enforce one-time use of each assertion ID.
396       *
397       * <p>
398       * Defaults to a per-process {@link InMemoryReplayCache}, which enforces single-use within one JVM; a
399       * warning is logged when the default is used.
400       * Multi-node deployments should inject a {@link ReplayCache} backed by a store shared across every node
401       * so an assertion consumed against one node cannot be replayed against another.  The check is always
402       * fail-closed: a cache that cannot answer causes the assertion to be rejected.
403       *
404       * @param value The replay cache.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
405       * @return This object.
406       */
407      public Builder replayCache(ReplayCache value) {
408         replayCache = reqnn("value", value);
409         return this;
410      }
411
412      /**
413       * Allows IdP-initiated responses, i.e. a bearer confirmation that carries no {@code InResponseTo}.
414       *
415       * <p>
416       * Off by default.  An unsolicited response cannot be bound to a request this SP made, so enable it only
417       * when the IdP starts the login flow.
418       *
419       * @return This object.
420       */
421      public Builder allowIdpInitiated() {
422         allowIdpInitiated = true;
423         return this;
424      }
425
426      /**
427       * Sets whether a response must carry an {@code <EncryptedAssertion>}; a plaintext {@code <Assertion>} is then rejected.
428       *
429       * <p>
430       * Defaults to <jk>true</jk> when a {@link #decryptionCredential(Credential) decryption credential} is configured
431       * and <jk>false</jk> otherwise.  Passing <jk>false</jk> explicitly lets a validator that holds a decryption
432       * credential also accept plaintext assertions.
433       *
434       * @param value Whether encrypted assertions are mandatory.
435       * @return This object.
436       */
437      public Builder requireEncryptedAssertions(boolean value) {
438         requireEncryptedAssertions = value;
439         return this;
440      }
441
442      /**
443       * Overrides the {@link AuthnRequestStore} that tracks outstanding authentication request IDs.
444       *
445       * <p>
446       * Defaults to a per-process {@link InMemoryAuthnRequestStore}, which holds up to
447       * {@link InMemoryAuthnRequestStore#DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES} IDs and is not shared between nodes; a warning is
448       * logged when the default is used.  Multi-node deployments should inject a store shared across every node.
449       *
450       * @param value The store.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
451       * @return This object.
452       */
453      public Builder authnRequestStore(AuthnRequestStore value) {
454         authnRequestStore = reqnn("value", value);
455         return this;
456      }
457
458      /**
459       * Sets how long a request ID registered with {@link SamlAssertionValidator#rememberAuthnRequest(String)}
460       * stays valid.  Defaults to 10 minutes.
461       *
462       * @param value The lifetime.  Must be positive.
463       * @return This object.
464       */
465      public Builder authnRequestTtl(Duration value) {
466         reqnn("value", value);
467         if (value.isNegative() || value.isZero())
468            throw iaex("authnRequestTtl must be positive");
469         authnRequestTtl = value;
470         return this;
471      }
472
473      /**
474       * Sets the clock-skew tolerance for {@code NotBefore} / {@code NotOnOrAfter} validation.
475       *
476       * @param value The tolerance.  Must be non-negative and not exceed 5 minutes.
477       * @return This object.
478       */
479      public Builder clockSkew(Duration value) {
480         reqnn("value", value);
481         if (value.isNegative())
482            throw iaex("clockSkew must be non-negative");
483         if (value.compareTo(MAX_CLOCK_SKEW) > 0)
484            throw iaex("clockSkew must not exceed 5 minutes (was %s)", value);
485         clockSkew = value;
486         return this;
487      }
488
489      /**
490       * Overrides the {@link Clock} used for timestamp validation.  Useful in tests.
491       *
492       * @param value The clock.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
493       * @return This object.
494       */
495      public Builder clock(Clock value) {
496         clock = reqnn("value", value);
497         return this;
498      }
499
500      /**
501       * Builds the validator.
502       *
503       * @return A new {@link SamlAssertionValidator}.
504       */
505      public SamlAssertionValidator build() {
506         if (spEntityId == null)
507            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator requires spEntityId(...)");
508         if (expectedIssuer == null)
509            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator requires expectedIssuer(...)");
510         if (metadataResolver == null && signingCredential == null)
511            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator requires either metadataResolver(...) or signingCredential(...)");
512         if (metadataResolver != null && signingCredential != null)
513            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator: metadataResolver(...) and signingCredential(...) are mutually exclusive");
514         if (recipient == null)
515            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator requires recipient(...) (the SP assertion consumer service URL)");
516         if (eq(Boolean.TRUE, requireEncryptedAssertions) && decryptionCredential == null)
517            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAssertionValidator: requireEncryptedAssertions(true) requires decryptionCredential(...)");
518         if (requireEncryptedAssertions == null)
519            requireEncryptedAssertions = decryptionCredential != null;
520         if (replayCache == null) {
521            LOG.warning("SamlAssertionValidator is using the default in-memory replay cache, which is not shared between nodes; configure replayCache(...) for multi-node deployments.");
522            replayCache = new InMemoryReplayCache();
523         }
524         if (authnRequestStore == null) {
525            LOG.warning("SamlAssertionValidator is using the default in-memory authentication request store, which is not shared between nodes; configure authnRequestStore(...) for multi-node deployments.");
526            authnRequestStore = new InMemoryAuthnRequestStore();
527         }
528         return new SamlAssertionValidator(this);
529      }
530   }

532   private final MetadataResolver metadataResolver;
533   private final Credential signingCredential;
534   private final Credential decryptionCredential;
535   private final String spEntityId;
536   private final String expectedIssuer;
537   private final String recipient;
538   private final String expectedInResponseTo;
539   private final String expectedAddress;
540   private final Set<String> algorithms;
541   private final Set<String> digestAlgorithms;
542   private final Duration clockSkew;
543   private final Clock clock;
544   private final ReplayCache replayCache;
545   private final boolean allowIdpInitiated;
546   private final boolean requireEncryptedAssertions;
547   private final Duration authnRequestTtl;
548   private final AuthnRequestStore authnRequestStore;
549
550   /** Attribute names that cannot replace the validator-set claims. */
551   private static final Set<String> RESERVED_CLAIMS = Set.of(ISSUER_TYPE_CLAIM, "iss", "aud");
552
553   /**
554    * Constructor.
555    *
556    * @param b The builder to read configuration from.
557    */
558   protected SamlAssertionValidator(Builder b) {
559      OpenSamlBootstrap.ensureInitialized();
560      this.metadataResolver = b.metadataResolver;
561      this.signingCredential = b.signingCredential;
562      this.decryptionCredential = b.decryptionCredential;
563      this.spEntityId = b.spEntityId;
564      this.expectedIssuer = b.expectedIssuer;
565      this.recipient = b.recipient;
566      this.expectedInResponseTo = b.expectedInResponseTo;
567      this.expectedAddress = b.expectedAddress;
568      this.algorithms = u(cp(b.algorithms));
569      this.digestAlgorithms = u(cp(b.digestAlgorithms));
570      this.clockSkew = b.clockSkew;
571      this.clock = b.clock;
572      this.replayCache = b.replayCache;
573      this.authnRequestStore = b.authnRequestStore;
574      this.allowIdpInitiated = b.allowIdpInitiated;
575      this.requireEncryptedAssertions = eq(Boolean.TRUE, b.requireEncryptedAssertions);
576      this.authnRequestTtl = b.authnRequestTtl;
577   }

615   /**
616    * Returns how long a request ID registered with {@link #rememberAuthnRequest(String)} stays valid.
617    *
618    * @return The request lifetime.
619    */
620   public Duration getAuthnRequestTtl() {
621      return authnRequestTtl;

623
624   /**
625    * Registers the ID of an authentication request this SP sent, so a response answering it can be accepted.
626    *
627    * <p>
628    * Each registered ID is accepted once and expires after the configured request lifetime.  The registry is the
629    * {@link AuthnRequestStore} supplied to {@link Builder#authnRequestStore(AuthnRequestStore)} (in-memory by default).
630    *
631    * <p>
632    * The ID is tied to the browser that starts the login.  This method generates a random secret, stores only its
633    * digest next to the ID, and returns the secret.  The caller must hand the returned value to the same browser
634    * (see {@link SamlAuthFilter#startLogin(HttpServletResponse, String)}) and the response must come back
635    * with that value, see {@link #validate(String, String)}.
636    *
637    * @param id The {@code ID} attribute of the outgoing {@code <AuthnRequest>}.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
638    * @return The browser-binding secret to give to the browser that will receive the response.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
639    * @throws IllegalStateException If the store cannot accept more outstanding requests.
640    */
641   public String rememberAuthnRequest(String id) {
642      reqnb("id", id);
643      var bytes = new byte[32];
644      SECURE_RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
645      var secret = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
646      var now = clock.millis();
647      authnRequestStore.remember(id, bindingDigest(secret), now + authnRequestTtl.toMillis(), now);
648      return secret;
649   }
650
651   private boolean consumeAuthnRequest(String id, String browserBinding) {
652      return authnRequestStore.consume(id, browserBinding == null ? null : bindingDigest(browserBinding), clock.millis());
653   }
654
655   private static byte[] bindingDigest(String secret) {
656      try {
657         return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(secret.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
658      } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
659         throw new IllegalStateException(e); // HTT: SHA-256 is always available
660      }
661   }

663   /**
664    * Validates the supplied SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} XML and returns the resolved principal.
665    *
666    * @param xml The full XML payload (already base64-decoded; already URL-decoded and inflated for the
667    *    REDIRECT binding).  Must be a {@code <samlp:Response>} envelope.
668    * @return A {@link ClaimsPrincipal} carrying the IdP-supplied claims plus the {@code issuerType=SAML}
669    *    marker.
670    * @throws AuthenticationException If the response cannot be parsed or validation fails.
671    */
672   public Principal validate(String xml) throws AuthenticationException {
673      return validate(xml, null);
674   }
675
676   /**
677    * Validates the supplied SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} XML for a response that arrived from a specific browser.
678    *
679    * <p>
680    * A response that answers a request registered with {@link #rememberAuthnRequest(String)} is accepted only when
681    * <c>browserBinding</c> is the secret that method returned for that request.
682    *
683    * @param xml The full XML payload.  Must be a {@code <samlp:Response>} envelope.
684    * @param browserBinding The binding secret presented by the browser, or <jk>null</jk> if it presented none.
685    * @return A {@link ClaimsPrincipal} carrying the IdP-supplied claims plus the {@code issuerType=SAML} marker.
686    * @throws AuthenticationException If the response cannot be parsed or validation fails.
687    */
688   public Principal validate(String xml, String browserBinding) throws AuthenticationException {
689      reqnb("xml", xml);
690      var response = parseResponse(xml);
691      validateStatus(response);
692      validateDestination(response);
693      var assertion = extractAndDecryptAssertion(response);
694      verifySignature(assertion);
695      var claims = buildClaims(response, assertion);
696      validateSubjectConfirmation(assertion, browserBinding);
697      recordSingleUse(assertion);
698      var subject = nameId(assertion);
699      return new ClaimsPrincipal(subject, claims);
700   }
701
702   private void validateDestination(Response response) throws AuthenticationException {
703      var destination = response.getDestination();
704      if (destination != null && neq(recipient, destination))
705         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML response <Destination> does not match the expected ACS URL")
706            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
707   }
708
709   private void validateStatus(Response response) throws AuthenticationException {
710      var status = response.getStatus();
711      var code = status == null ? null : status.getStatusCode();
712      var value = code == null ? null : code.getValue();
713      if (neq(StatusCode.SUCCESS, value))
714         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML response status is not Success: " + value)
715            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
716   }
717
718   private Response parseResponse(String xml) throws AuthenticationException {
719      try {
720         var doc = SamlXml.newDocumentBuilder().parse(new ByteArrayInputStream(xml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
721         Element root = doc.getDocumentElement();
722         var registry = XMLObjectProviderRegistrySupport.getUnmarshallerFactory();
723         var unmarshaller = registry.getUnmarshaller(root);
724         if (unmarshaller == null)
725            throw new AuthenticationException("Unknown SAML element: " + root.getNodeName())
726               .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
727         var obj = unmarshaller.unmarshall(root);
728         if (!(obj instanceof Response obj2))
729            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML envelope is not a <Response>: " + cns(obj))
730               .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
731         return obj2;
732      } catch (UnmarshallingException | ParserConfigurationException | IOException | SAXException e) {
733         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML response could not be parsed")
734            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
735      }
736   }
737
738   private Assertion extractAndDecryptAssertion(Response response) throws AuthenticationException {
739      var assertions = response.getAssertions();
740      var encrypted = response.getEncryptedAssertions();
741      if (assertions.isEmpty() && encrypted.isEmpty())
742         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML response contains no <Assertion>")
743            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_response\"");
744      if (!encrypted.isEmpty()) {
745         if (decryptionCredential == null) {
746            LOG.fine("SAML response contains <EncryptedAssertion> but no decryption credential is configured");
747            throw decryptionFailed();
748         }
749         var resolver = (KeyInfoCredentialResolver) new StaticKeyInfoCredentialResolver(decryptionCredential);
750         EncryptedKeyResolver keyResolver = new ChainingEncryptedKeyResolver(List.of(
751            new InlineEncryptedKeyResolver(),
752            new SimpleRetrievalMethodEncryptedKeyResolver()
753         ));
754         try {
755            var decrypter = new Decrypter(null, resolver, keyResolver, DECRYPTION_ALGORITHMS, null);
756            decrypter.setRootInNewDocument(true);
757            return decrypter.decrypt(encrypted.get(0));
758         } catch (DecryptionException | RuntimeException e) {
759            LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "SAML <EncryptedAssertion> could not be decrypted");
760            throw decryptionFailed();
761         }
762      }
763      if (requireEncryptedAssertions) {
764         LOG.fine("SAML response carries a plaintext <Assertion> but encrypted assertions are required");
765         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML assertion must be encrypted")
766            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"encryption_required\"");
767      }
768      return assertions.get(0);
769   }
770
771   private static AuthenticationException decryptionFailed() {
772      return new AuthenticationException("SAML response could not be decrypted")
773         .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"decryption_failed\"");
774   }
775
776   private void verifySignature(Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
777      var signature = assertion.getSignature();
778      if (signature == null)
779         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML assertion is unsigned")
780            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"signature_required\"");
781
782      var alg = signature.getSignatureAlgorithm();
783      if (alg == null || !algorithms.contains(alg)) // HTT: alg==null unreachable; a signature with no SignatureMethod is rejected while parsing the response
784         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML signature algorithm not allowlisted: " + alg)
785            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"signature_algorithm_rejected\"");
786
787      validateDigestAlgorithms(signature);
788
789      // First, run the SAML signature profile validator to catch wrapping/structural attacks.
790      try {
791         new SAMLSignatureProfileValidator().validate(signature);
792      } catch (SignatureException e) {
793         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML signature profile validation failed")
794            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"signature_invalid\"");
795      }
796
797      Credential credential = resolveSigningCredential();
798      try {
799         SignatureValidator.validate(signature, credential);
800      } catch (SignatureException e) {
801         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML signature verification failed")
802            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"signature_invalid\"");
803      }
804   }
805
806   private Credential resolveSigningCredential() throws AuthenticationException {
807      if (signingCredential != null)
808         return signingCredential;
809      var idp = resolveIdpDescriptor();
810      var credential = extractSigningCredential(idp);
811      if (credential == null)
812         throw new AuthenticationException("No signing X.509 certificate in metadata for issuer: " + expectedIssuer)
813            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"metadata_invalid\"");
814      return credential;
815   }
816
817   private IDPSSODescriptor resolveIdpDescriptor() throws AuthenticationException {
818      try {
819         var criteria = new CriteriaSet(
820            new EntityIdCriterion(expectedIssuer),
821            new EntityRoleCriterion(IDPSSODescriptor.DEFAULT_ELEMENT_NAME)
822         );
823         var entityDescriptor = metadataResolver.resolveSingle(criteria);
824         if (entityDescriptor == null)
825            throw new AuthenticationException("No SAML metadata for issuer: " + expectedIssuer)
826               .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"metadata_missing\"");
827         var idp = entityDescriptor.getIDPSSODescriptor(SAMLConstants.SAML20P_NS);
828         if (idp == null)
829            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML metadata for issuer has no IDPSSODescriptor")
830               .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"metadata_invalid\"");
831         return idp;
832      } catch (ResolverException e) {
833         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML metadata resolution failed")
834            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"metadata_invalid\"");
835      }
836   }
837
838   private Credential extractSigningCredential(IDPSSODescriptor idp) {
839      for (KeyDescriptor kd : idp.getKeyDescriptors()) {
840         var credential = credentialFromKeyDescriptor(kd);
841         if (credential != null)
842            return credential;
843      }
844      return null;
845   }
846
847   private Credential credentialFromKeyDescriptor(KeyDescriptor kd) {
848      if (!isSigningKey(kd))
849         return null;
850      var keyInfo = kd.getKeyInfo();
851      if (keyInfo == null)
852         return null;
853      for (var x509 : keyInfo.getX509Datas()) {
854         var credential = credentialFromX509Data(x509);
855         if (credential != null)
856            return credential;
857      }
858      return null;
859   }
860
861   private Credential credentialFromX509Data(X509Data x509) {
862      for (var cert : x509.getX509Certificates()) {
863         var base64 = cert.getValue();
864         if (base64 == null)
865            continue;
866         var credential = parseX509Credential(base64);
867         if (credential != null)
868            return credential;
869      }
870      return null;
871   }
872
873   private static boolean isSigningKey(KeyDescriptor kd) {
874      return kd.getUse() == null || kd.getUse() == UsageType.SIGNING || kd.getUse() == UsageType.UNSPECIFIED;
875   }
876
877   private BasicX509Credential parseX509Credential(String base64) {
878      try {
879         var bytes = Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(base64);
880         var cf = CertificateFactory.getInstance("X.509");
881         var certificate = (X509Certificate) cf.generateCertificate(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes));
882         // The metadata signing cert is the trust anchor; reject one outside its validity window so an
883         // expired (or not-yet-valid) cert can no longer be used to verify assertions.
884         certificate.checkValidity(Date.from(clock.instant()));
885         return new BasicX509Credential(certificate);
886      } catch (CertificateException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
887         return null;  // Expired/not-yet-valid or malformed cert: caller tries the next certificate.
888      }
889   }

891   private Map<String,Object> buildClaims(Response response, Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
892      validateConditions(assertion);
893      validateIssuer(response, assertion);
894
895      Map<String,Object> claims = m(ISSUER_TYPE_CLAIM, ISSUER_TYPE_SAML, "iss", expectedIssuer, "aud", spEntityId);
896
897      for (var stmt : assertion.getAttributeStatements()) {
898         for (var attr : stmt.getAttributes()) {
899            var name = attr.getName();
900            if (name == null || RESERVED_CLAIMS.contains(name))
901               continue;
902            var values = l();
903            for (var av : attr.getAttributeValues())
904               values.add(extractStringValue(av));
905            if (values.size() == 1)
906               claims.put(name, values.get(0));
907            else if (!values.isEmpty())
908               claims.put(name, values);
909         }
910      }
911      return claims;
912   }
913
914   private void validateConditions(Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
915      var conditions = assertion.getConditions();
916      if (conditions == null)
917         throw rejectAssertion("missing <Conditions>");
918
919      var now = clock.instant();
920      var nbf = conditions.getNotBefore();
921      var noa = conditions.getNotOnOrAfter();
922      if (nbf != null && nbf.minus(clockSkew).isAfter(now))
923         throw rejectAssertion("assertion not yet valid");
924      if (noa != null && !noa.plus(clockSkew).isAfter(now))
925         throw rejectAssertion("assertion has expired");
926
927      boolean audienceOk = false;
928      for (var ar : conditions.getAudienceRestrictions()) {
929         for (var aud : ar.getAudiences()) {
930            if (eq(spEntityId, aud.getURI())) {
931               audienceOk = true;
932               break;
933            }
934         }
935      }
936      if (!audienceOk)
937         throw rejectAssertion("audience does not include SP entity ID: " + spEntityId);
938   }
939
940   private void validateIssuer(Response response, Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
941      var assertionIssuer = assertion.getIssuer();
942      if (assertionIssuer == null || neq(expectedIssuer, assertionIssuer.getValue()))
943         throw rejectAssertion("assertion <Issuer> does not match expected issuer");
944      var respIssuer = response.getIssuer();
945      if (respIssuer != null && neq(expectedIssuer, respIssuer.getValue()))
946         throw rejectAssertion("response <Issuer> does not match expected issuer");
947   }
948
949   private void validateDigestAlgorithms(Signature signature) throws AuthenticationException {
950      var dom = signature.getDOM();
951      if (dom == null) // HTT: null DOM unreachable; a verifiable signature is always marshalled to DOM
952         return; // HTT: null DOM unreachable; a verifiable signature is always marshalled to DOM
953      var digestNodes = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(XMLSIG_NS, "DigestMethod");
954      for (var i = 0; i < digestNodes.getLength(); i++) {
955         var alg = ((Element) digestNodes.item(i)).getAttribute("Algorithm");
956         if (alg == null || alg.isEmpty() || alg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("sha1") || !digestAlgorithms.contains(alg)) // HTT: the alg==null clause is unreachable because Element.getAttribute never returns null; kept as a fail-closed guard
957            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML signature digest algorithm not allowlisted: " + alg)
958               .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"signature_algorithm_rejected\"");
959      }
960   }
961
962   private void validateSubjectConfirmation(Assertion assertion, String browserBinding) throws AuthenticationException {
963      var subject = assertion.getSubject();
964      if (subject == null)
965         throw rejectAssertion("missing <Subject> for bearer confirmation");
966      String failure = null;
967      var sawBearer = false;
968      for (var sc : subject.getSubjectConfirmations()) {
969         if (neq(SubjectConfirmation.METHOD_BEARER, sc.getMethod()))
970            continue;
971         sawBearer = true;
972         var reason = confirmationFailureReason(sc, browserBinding);
973         if (reason == null)
974            return;  // A valid bearer confirmation was found.
975         failure = reason;
976      }
977      if (! sawBearer)
978         throw rejectAssertion("missing bearer <SubjectConfirmation>");
979      throw rejectAssertion(failure);
980   }
981
982   @SuppressWarnings({
983      "java:S3776" // Branching is inherent to the ordered bearer-confirmation checks.
984   })
985   private String confirmationFailureReason(SubjectConfirmation sc, String browserBinding) {
986      var data = sc.getSubjectConfirmationData();
987      if (data == null)
988         return "bearer <SubjectConfirmationData> is missing";
989      if (neq(recipient, data.getRecipient()))
990         return "bearer confirmation <Recipient> does not match the expected ACS URL";
991      var now = clock.instant();
992      var noa = data.getNotOnOrAfter();
993      if (noa == null)
994         return "bearer confirmation is missing NotOnOrAfter";
995      if (! noa.plus(clockSkew).isAfter(now))
996         return "bearer confirmation has expired";
997      var nbf = data.getNotBefore();
998      if (nbf != null && nbf.minus(clockSkew).isAfter(now))
999         return "bearer confirmation is not yet valid";
1000      var inResponseTo = data.getInResponseTo();
1001      var hasInResponseTo = inResponseTo != null && ! inResponseTo.isEmpty(); // HTT: OpenSAML trims an empty InResponseTo to null; kept as a fail-closed guard
1002      if (expectedInResponseTo != null) {
1003         if (neq(expectedInResponseTo, inResponseTo))
1004            return "bearer confirmation <InResponseTo> does not match the expected request ID";
1005      } else if (hasInResponseTo) {
1006         if (! consumeAuthnRequest(inResponseTo, browserBinding))
1007            return "bearer confirmation <InResponseTo> does not reference an outstanding request";
1008      } else if (! allowIdpInitiated) {
1009         return "unsolicited (IdP-initiated) responses are not allowed";
1010      }
1011      if (expectedAddress != null && neq(expectedAddress, data.getAddress()))
1012         return "bearer confirmation <Address> does not match the expected client address";
1013      return null;
1014   }
1015
1016   private void recordSingleUse(Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
1017      var id = assertion.getID();
1018      if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) // HTT: OpenSAML trims an empty ID to null, so the isEmpty() branch cannot run; kept as a fail-closed guard
1019         throw rejectAssertion("assertion has no ID for single-use enforcement");
1020      var notOnOrAfter = resolveNotOnOrAfter(assertion);
1021      if (notOnOrAfter == null)
1022         throw rejectAssertion("assertion has no NotOnOrAfter to bound one-time use");
1023      var expiresAtMs = notOnOrAfter.plus(clockSkew).toEpochMilli();
1024      var firstSeen = replayCache.checkAndRecord(id, expiresAtMs, ReplayCache.FailMode.FAIL_CLOSED,
1025         e -> LOG.log(Level.WARNING, e, () -> "SAML assertion single-use check failed; rejecting (fail-closed)."));
1026      if (! firstSeen)
1027         throw new AuthenticationException("SAML assertion has already been presented")
1028            .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"assertion_replayed\"");
1029   }
1030
1031   /**
1032    * Resolves the effective {@code NotOnOrAfter} that bounds one-time use of the assertion.
1033    *
1034    * <p>
1035    * The resolved value is the latest of the assertion's {@code Conditions/NotOnOrAfter} and any bearer
1036    * {@code SubjectConfirmationData/NotOnOrAfter}.  Returns <jk>null</jk> when the assertion carries neither
1037    * &mdash; in that case its validity window is unbounded, so single-use cannot be enforced past a cache
1038    * eviction and the caller rejects the assertion rather than inventing a short fallback that later re-opens
1039    * replay.  {@code <Conditions>} itself is guaranteed non-<jk>null</jk> here (a null {@code <Conditions>} is
1040    * rejected earlier by {@link #validateConditions(Assertion)}).
1041    *
1042    * @param assertion The assertion.
1043    * @return The latest bounding instant, or <jk>null</jk> if the assertion carries no {@code NotOnOrAfter}.
1044    */
1045   private static Instant resolveNotOnOrAfter(Assertion assertion) {
1046      var result = assertion.getConditions().getNotOnOrAfter();
1047      var subject = assertion.getSubject();
1048      if (subject != null) {
1049         for (var sc : subject.getSubjectConfirmations()) {
1050            var noa = bearerNotOnOrAfter(sc);
1051            if (noa != null && (result == null || noa.isAfter(result)))
1052               result = noa;
1053         }
1054      }
1055      return result;
1056   }
1057
1058   /**
1059    * Returns the {@code NotOnOrAfter} of {@code sc}'s {@code <SubjectConfirmationData>} if {@code sc} is a
1060    * bearer confirmation carrying one, or <jk>null</jk> otherwise.
1061    *
1062    * @param sc The subject confirmation.
1063    * @return The bearer confirmation's {@code NotOnOrAfter}, or <jk>null</jk>.
1064    */
1065   private static Instant bearerNotOnOrAfter(SubjectConfirmation sc) {
1066      if (neq(SubjectConfirmation.METHOD_BEARER, sc.getMethod()))
1067         return null;
1068      var data = sc.getSubjectConfirmationData();
1069      return data == null ? null : data.getNotOnOrAfter();
1070   }
1071
1072   private static String extractStringValue(XMLObject av) {
1073      if (av == null) // HTT: null av unreachable; OpenSAML attribute value lists never contain null entries
1074         return null; // HTT: null av unreachable; OpenSAML attribute value lists never contain null entries
1075      var dom = av.getDOM();
1076      if (dom != null) // HTT: the response is always parsed from XML, so every unmarshalled value carries its DOM
1077         return dom.getTextContent();
1078      return av.toString(); // HTT: the response is always parsed from XML, so every unmarshalled value carries its DOM
1079   }
1080
1081   private static String nameId(Assertion assertion) throws AuthenticationException {
1082      var subject = assertion.getSubject();
1083      var nameID = subject == null ? null : subject.getNameID();
1084      if (nameID == null || nameID.getValue() == null || nameID.getValue().isBlank())
1085         throw rejectAssertion("missing <NameID> subject");
1086      return nameID.getValue();
1087   }

1089   private static AuthenticationException rejectAssertion(String reason) {
1090      return new AuthenticationException("SAML assertion rejected: " + reason)
1091         .wwwAuthenticate("SAML error=\"invalid_assertion\"");
1092   }
